suites.description: CCR-05847 — safe staged ingestion with batch identity, validation and provenance

checks.name: representative export stages every conversation under one batch identity
invalid exports are rejected before any canonical write
provenance is bound to the exact staged source, not caller claims

suites.description: CCR-05848 — the complete available message graph is imported, not titles or final messages

checks.name: every mapping node is inventoried including empty structural roots
branch text is never flattened into a single fabricated chronology

suites.description: CCR-05849 — divergent branches keep their lineage and invalid graphs are rejected

checks.name: graph validation reports the real branch point and accepts the fixture
missing parents, cycles, duplicate children and mismatched links are rejected

suites.description: CCR-05850 — container identity is preserved as lineage, never as canonical truth

checks.name: containers group conversations by their historical template identity
container membership never becomes a current canonical project claim

suites.description: CCR-05851 — missing artifacts keep their reference and originals are tried before reconstruction

checks.name: original recovery is attempted before any reconstruction
reconstruction is allowed only after exhaustion, is labelled, and cannot masquerade as the original
unauthorized, duplicated and dishonest attempts are rejected

suites.description: CCR-05852 — the completeness report matches the staged graph exactly

checks.name: the audited report matches the real staged graph and keeps missing artifacts open
forged counts, hidden privacy exclusions and wrong provenance are rejected
scope, digest, access and evidence failures fail closed
completeness requires every declared dimension and exact counts

suites.description: Secrets and private content never leak and recovery is deterministic

checks.name: private branch content is excluded from the stage and from the report
credential-shaped content is never staged as plaintext
recovery output is deterministic for the same source
